headline: Skyworks posts AMS automation roles for an agentic platform and a student AI workflow project
fact: Skyworks posted an AI Automation & Software Developer co-op on August 20 for January–June 2027 in Cedar Rapids. It assigns evaluation of AI tools and software workflows for circuit design and verification; behavioral modeling, Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog and analog/RF design are desired background. Separately, an August 24 design-automation role says a central engineering team is building an AI-enabled analog and mixed-signal design and verification platform, with agentic connections to EDA simulation, DRC, LVS, electromigration and compute schedulers, and support for real-number-modeling workflows. The descriptions do not establish that the co-op works on the same platform or that either project is deployed.

sources.title: Skyworks Careers: AI Automation & Software Developer Co-op (Winter/Spring 2027), requisition 78222
sources.summary: Official posting start date is August 20, 2026; the work term is January–June 2027. The current title and duties concern AI/software workflow development, with HDL and behavioral modeling as desired background; the URL retains an older title.
